preview.tagline: A luxury design studio needed a website matching their creative work. I built an animated Next.js site with GSAP and a custom CMS for independent content management.
preview.description: Complete redesign of the corporate website with integrated content management system. Delivered a modern, SEO-optimized platform that reflects the brand's creative excellence.

key_points.modern_experience: Animated, interactive experience built with Next.js 15 and GSAP
key_points.admin_panel: Custom admin panel with Lexical editor for autonomous content management
key_points.seo_optimization: Advanced SEO implementation with JSON-LD and dynamic metadata

details.challenge: A luxury design studio needed a professional website with autonomous content management. The old site was static with no portfolio structure, no SEO, and required developer intervention for all updates.
details.solution: Built a dual-platform system: an animated Next.js 15 website with GSAP animations and a custom admin panel with Lexical editor. The team can now publish services, portfolio pieces, and blog content independently. Integrated Zoho CRM for lead management and implemented technical SEO with JSON-LD schemas.

preview.tagline: Field teams struggled with an outdated web tool. I redesigned their CRM as a mobile-first app with interactive maps and offline capability for iOS and Android.
preview.description: Complete redesign of internal CRM/project management platform. Transformed an outdated web tool into a mobile-optimized application deployed as native iOS and Android apps.

key_points.mobile_optimization: Mobile-first redesign for installers and route managers working in the field
key_points.route_management: Interactive map integration, incident reporting, and real-time notifications
key_points.native_deployment: WebView deployment as downloadable iOS and Android apps

details.challenge: An internal web tool for field teams needed mobile optimization. The outdated interface wasn't responsive and hindered route coordination workflows.
details.solution: Rebuilt the platform as a mobile-first application with interactive maps for route visualization, incident reporting, and push notifications. Maintained Zoho CRM integration while fixing legacy bugs. Deployed as native iOS/Android apps using WebView technology for offline-capable field usage.

preview.tagline: Solar panel clients were juggling 7 different provider apps to monitor their installations. I built a unified platform consolidating all data into one dashboard, plus an admin CRM for client management.
preview.description: Full-stack platform unifying multiple solar providers into a single interface. Built dual role system: client monitoring dashboard and internal CRM for plant management.

key_points.data_unification: Single access point consolidating Victron, SolarEdge, and GoodWe data
key_points.dual_interface: Client dashboard for monitoring + admin CRM for user and plant management
key_points.native_experience: WebView deployment providing native app experience on iOS and Android

details.challenge: Solar plant clients were juggling three different vendor platforms (Victron, SolarEdge, GoodWe) with separate logins. The company had no unified tool for client management or revenue tracking.
details.solution: Built a dual-role platform with Next.js and Redux Toolkit. Clients access all their plants in one dashboard showing production, consumption, battery status, and savings. Admins use an integrated CRM for user/plant management and custom pricing calculations. Deployed as native iOS/Android apps via WebView for mobile-first access.

preview.tagline: A French carpentry business had no online presence. I built them an SEO-optimized website that ranks locally and generates leads through contact forms.
preview.description: Professional website built to establish online presence and compete effectively in the local market. Focused on SEO optimization and lead generation.

key_points.seo_boost: SEO-optimized structure to outrank local competition
key_points.online_presence: Modern, professional website reflecting quality craftsmanship
key_points.lead_generation: Contact form integration for direct client acquisition

details.challenge: A local carpentry business needed online visibility to compete in their French market. No existing website meant zero SEO presence.
details.solution: Built an SEO-optimized business website with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Implemented technical SEO with proper schemas, integrated EmailJS for contact forms, and deployed on Vercel for fast performance. Simple, clean design showcasing their carpentry services and portfolio.

key_points.brand_reinvention: Complete reinvention of Galaga's online presence
key_points.modern_tech: Powered by Next.js 15, TypeScript, GSAP, and Three.js

reloj_laboral.title: Reloj Laboral — Digital Time Tracking System

preview.tagline: Spanish companies need compliant digital time tracking by law. I built a custom full-stack system with separate interfaces for employees, admins, and inspectors tailored to the company's specific needs.
preview.description: I designed and developed Reloj Laboral, a full-stack platform that enables companies to comply with Spain's 2025 labor regulations. The system includes distinct interfaces for employees, administrators, and official inspectors — all connected through a secure and auditable infrastructure.

key_points.digital_compliance: Compliant with the 2025 Spanish digital labor law
key_points.full_stack: End-to-end solution — frontend, backend, and database architecture
key_points.multi_role_system: Custom dashboards for employees, admins, and inspectors

details.challenge: Spanish companies required compliant digital time tracking by law (Article 34.9). Existing solutions were outdated or non-compliant. Needed a full-stack system with employee, admin, and inspector roles.
details.solution: Built a complete PERN stack application (PostgreSQL, Express, React 18, Node.js) with JWT authentication and role-based access. Frontend uses Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP. Features include real-time tracking, monthly PDF exports, correction workflows, and full audit trails for legal compliance. Initially used Supabase, later migrated to custom backend for complete control.
